data.name: Casimira
data.gender_notes: Casimira is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin 'Casimirus', composed of 'casus' (fallen) and 'marius' (of the sea). Casimira signifies 'devoted to the Lord' or 'resembling Marius'. In Christianity, Casimira is associated with St. Casimir, a Polish prince who displayed great devotion to the Blessed Virgin Mary. The name Casimira carries the meaning “Devoted to the Lord” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Casimira usually hope their child will grow to embody devoted to the lord and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes deep devotion and commitment to God.
data.etymology: Casimira belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Devoted to the Lord.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Casimira total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_hebrew.name: קאזימירא
in_hebrew.meaning: השם קאזימירא נגזר מהשם הסלאבי קאזימיר, שפירושו 'השומר על השלום'
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם קאזימירא הוא נגזר מהשם הסלאבי קאזימיר, שמורכב משתי מילים: 'קאזי' שפירושו 'להשמר' ו-'מיר' שפירושו 'שלום'. השם קאזימירא הוא בעל משמעות עמוקה ומרמז על שמירת השלום והאחדות. השם נמצא בשימוש בקרב הנוצרים והוא נושא משמעות רוחנית חשובה.

in_greek.name: Καζιμίρα
in_greek.meaning: Το όνομα Καζιμίρα σημαίνει 'εκείνη που φυλάει την ειρήνη'
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Καζιμίρα προέρχεται από το σλαβικό όνομα Καζίμιρ, το οποίο αποτελείται από δύο λέξεις: 'κάσι' που σημαίνει 'να φυλάει' και 'μίρ' που σημαίνει 'ειρήνη'. Το όνομα Καζιμίρα έχει βαθιά σημασία και υποδηλώνει τη φύλαξη της ειρήνης και της ενότητας. Το όνομα αυτό χρησιμοποιείται μεταξύ των Χριστιανών και φέρει σημαντική πνευματική σημασία.

in_latin.name: Casimira
in_latin.meaning: The name Casimira means 'peacekeeper' or 'one who guards peace'
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Casimira originates from the Slavic name Casimir, which is derived from two words: 'kazi' meaning 'to guard' and 'mir' meaning 'peace'. The name Casimira holds a profound meaning, signifying the guardian of peace and unity. This name is used among Christians and carries significant spiritual connotations.

in_english.name: Casimira
in_english.meaning: The name Casimira means 'peacekeeper' or 'one who guards peace'
in_english.long_meaning: The name Casimira originates from the Slavic name Casimir, which is derived from the Polish words 'kazic' meaning 'to keep' and 'mir' meaning 'peace'. This name has been adopted in Christian traditions and symbolizes the guardian of peace, harmony, and unity. The name Casimira reflects the values of serenity, protection, and spiritual growth.
